end.summary:
Defined food miles as the distance from where food is grown or made to the plate.
Identified that local food usually travels less and may stay fresher.
Discussed fuel, electricity for cooling, packaging and waste linked with food transport.
Comparison of foods by distance and effects needs more practice; teach-back was not completed.
end.parentNote: Rohan practised defining food miles and tracing food from its source to the plate. They used the idea of choosing nearby food to explain shorter travel and discussed fuel, cooling, packaging and waste; the meaning of “fuel” was clarified during the lesson (correctAfterLastSeen). At home, ask Rohan to compare two foods in the kitchen and say which travelled farther and why that may affect freshness or pollution.
